buildCommand: (node scripts/db-init.js 2>/dev/null || node ../scripts/db-init.js 2>/dev/null || true) && (cd ../frontend 2>/dev/null || cd frontend) && npm install && npm run build && (mkdir -p ../backend/frontend/dist 2>/dev/null && cp -r dist/* ../backend/frontend/dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
installCommand: npm install && (npx prisma generate || npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma || npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma)
